authorization: user requested recovery and continued experiments; bounded local CPU only; no paid compute

latency.scope: conservative pilot promotion screen against fastest registered cold; not a confidence interval; current evidence verification included

storage.scope: complete state; common base checkpoint and audit archive excluded

historical_evidence.scope: Immutable published metadata checked; historical model/state binaries are unavailable. Prior successful evidence only.

lifetime_limit: No per-root original model-only preparation baseline; this pilot cannot establish lifetime break-even or isolated caching overhead.
primary_clock: controller after prerequisite/bootstrap checks through worker receipt and receipt hash

recovery.comparison_scope: Within the new root and registered runtime only; no historical latency enters a new gate.
recovery.historical_gate_scope: Immutable published metadata checked; historical model/state binaries are unavailable. Prior successful evidence only.

lost_unpublished_context.status: unverified conversation context, no receipt or ledger survives

recovery.statistical_scope: Development replication; prior selection remains fixed; no confirmation or population interval.
recovery.stop_rule: No retry or source replacement. Finish both selected roots after scientific losses. Execution or exactness failures block dependent work.
